skill: Identify ordinary matrices in row echelon form, or its complement, by checking leading-entry positions and placement of zero rows.
learner_operation: Find the first nonzero entry in each nonzero row; require strictly increasing column indices and no nonzero row after a zero row. Apply the requested in/not-in polarity independently to each labeled matrix.
reasoning_steps: Locate zero rows and leading entries.
Check both row echelon conditions for each matrix.
Select exactly the qualifying labels; explain a concrete violation for rejected matrices.
response_contract: Thirteen easy questions use three checkbox fields containing labeled matrices with true/false banks. One incomplete radio source has five subset choices, absent key and absent solution; its mathematical result is B only, an independently inferred correction. Canonical example is explanatory rather than answer-field evidence.
difficulty: Easy recognition on small integer matrices, mostly 3–5 rows, 3–6 columns; no row operations, solving systems, or reduced-row-echelon requirements.
invariants: Zero rows must be below all nonzero rows.
Leading columns strictly increase down the nonzero rows.
Leading entries need not equal one; entries above pivots need not vanish.
Each field key, solution matrix, selection truth and requested polarity must agree.
Retain source banks and response type when replaying each source.

fixed_features.justification: All target questions present three independent recognition decisions; augmented matrices and transformation tasks are neighboring skills.
Explicit lesson definition, tutorial 137b0909-9a5e-5edf-8019-24e803307903 conditions I and II.

permitted_variations: Change nonzero values, signs and entries to the right of pivots while deriving explanations.
Change zero-row location, pivot-column sequences (increasing, repeated, decreasing), dimensions within comparable workload.
Reassign qualifying status to any label or shape; neither A/B/C nor source profile determines truth.
Vary in/not-in polarity and subset size, including source-observed all-three cases; do not fix eligible qualifying labels.
Reorder presentations and fields without stale labels, keys or solutions.
